notesForTheReviewer: One observation from the deletion, not a defect and not a round-stopper. deliveryOutcome.exceptionFailureRetries is now dead in the same way the deleted helper was. The round that deleted one unreachable NAK-on-an-unpublishable-notice left this one standing; naming it so the decision is on the record. The live retry on that path is `retry: retryable`, which is unaffected.
